import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": ["A", "B", "C"],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [200, 300, 400]
})

df_nw = nw.from_native(df)

df_long = df_nw.unpivot(
    index="id",
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

result = df_long.to_native()
print(result)
